name: VA-10
label: Safe D

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Subramanyam: a D+6 district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over a little-known challenger, with markets pricing the race as effectively decided. With no polling available, the margin stays near the fundamentals estimate but uncertainty remains wide.
model.watch: A late outside-spending surge against Subramanyam or an unusually favorable national environment for Republicans could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northern Virginia's 10th District leans Democratic, and first-term incumbent Suhas Subramanyam is seeking re-election after easily winning the seat. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds a cash advantage of more than ten to one over Republican Dave Beckwith, who has raised about $107,000. No outside groups are currently spending against the incumbent.

No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have listed the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and prediction markets, which price the Democrat at 95 to 97 percent. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with a wide but manageable uncertainty band given the absence of polling.
